title: La Mano Pottery

services.name: Hand Building
services.desc: The class fee includes clay and glazes, and one or two practice sessions depending on the length of the course. Students provide their own tools, aprons and towels. Firing fees are invoiced on a monthly basis. The cost is 5 cents per cubic inch for each piece fired (covering both the bisque and glaze firing).

explain.meaning: Shaping clay with your hands, without a wheel.

services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: Expert instructors are available for basic or advanced hand building or wheel lessons, for individuals or groups, scheduled at mutually convenient times. Private lessons are $170/person for a two-hour session. Additional fees are applied after completion if you want to keep what you make. The cost is $20/piece and we will fire and glaze for you. Finished pieces will be ready for pick up 3-4 weeks later. Payment is due prior to the event and 24 hours cancellation notice required for full refund.
